'''Vweilu nuts''' were an integral ingredient of [[Mynock Coronet City/Legends|Mynock Coronet City]], [[Ryshcate/Legends|ryshcate]], and [[Corellian whiskey/Legends|Corellian whiskey]]. They were also served with [[csolcir]].
